name: One fixed chronological Platt appearance correction
status: declared before calibration fits and new decision/season effects
diagnosis: Current proposed-squad appearance marginal underprediction in both inspected years; no evidence of extreme implied conditional-return inflation. Joint residuals confounded by marginal calibration.

candidate.method: LogisticRegression on logit(p_play), C1, lbfgs, max_iter200, random_state20261026; no class balancing; two parameters; no alternatives or tuning
candidate.training_cohort: All prior-season origin/player cells for GW1..37 with positive fixture count, nonzero p and no official-zero flag; matched stable code in following origin; next origin confirms current event finished/data_checked; nonnegative cumulative-minute increment. Labels are historical API minute-increment proxies as recorded then, not later corrected histories. Exclude incomplete/ambiguous records with counts.
candidate.training_sources: Train2023/24 -> test2024/25; train2024/25 -> test2025/26. Each prior-year next-origin label clock must strictly precede each target origin. No target-year label fitting. No calibration before2024/25.
candidate.application: Map origin-frozen player-GW p over all six horizon leads with same transform. Preserve explicit official-zero/no-fixture/zero-support cells. Do not regularise again. Unconditional mean grid exactly unchanged. Nonnegative slope required; otherwise candidate is invalid, not replaced.
candidate.clock: Historical simulated training-data cutoff distinct from actual2026 execution time; archive clocks remain publisher claims. Counter revisions can contaminate minute-increment labels; compare label disagreement diagnostically, never select training rows using later corrected truth.

components.primary: Equal-season mean current-player-GW Brier relative change; all market and frozen ex-ante proposed-squad union, each season retained. Reliability bins/counts, no independence CI.
components.quality: At least0.5% mean relative Brier reduction; no season relative Brier deterioration above1%; identity of point mean grid, frozen errors/coverage and all flags required. Results may fail. This gate is research only and does not replace live promotion gates.
components.secondary: Implied conditional-return errors on played subset; prior fixed proposal first-action overlays; joint count residuals; unchanged-point MAE/RMSE must be reported.

seasons.older_extension: 2023/24 uncalibrated H6, availability-aware H6, adapted Solio, two declared common openings/two fixed-work repetitions:12paths. Historical reference fit2020/21..2022/23; old validation exposure disclosed.
seasons.candidate: 2024/25 and2025/26 calibrated availability-aware H6, same two starts/two repetitions:8newpaths; reuse hash-verified identical24prior controls, including uncalibrated availability-H6/H6/adaptedSolio.
seasons.work: node_limit1, max_trials6, seed0, paralleloff,2threads,120sinner safety/900spath safety, original horizon6/all legal ordinary chips
seasons.primary: Calibrated candidate minus original uncalibrated availability-aware H6 on old two years, equal-season mean across opening cases; also versus H6 and adapted Solio. Older extension is a separate additional historical-policy comparison, not a calibrated-candidate gain.
seasons.criterion: Positive equal-season mean; each season mean >=-19; every common-opening mean >=-38; exact repeated decision/source/finance fingerprints and independent outcome/legality audits. Retain previous thresholds/results unchanged; these are operational downside budgets, not significance tests.
seasons.uncertainty: Two calibration target years plus one older policy year, all with prior research exposure; repeated solver paths not independent football seasons. Report every loss, mean and downside separately; no general/original-manager/forecast superiority claim.

resources.fit_fold_count: One older four-head reference fold + two tiny probability-calibration folds =3

release: No automatic forecaster/default promotion. Historical calibrated policy only; no target-year search, current-input backcast, future-game wait or private publication.
